title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly,

translated_title: 面向思维剪枝的直接 Pass@$k$ 优化：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展已成为推理模型的一项关键推理策略：模型会生成大量候选解，以期能找到至少一个正确解。由于将所有候选解都运行到底在计算上代价高昂，近期的工作选择在仅生成一小段前缀后就对候选池进行剪枝，只为保留下来的候选分配后续计算资源。现有剪枝策略大致分为两类：基于质量的方法为每个部分解打分，并丢弃那些被预测最终会得到错误答案的部分解；而基于多样性的方法则选择遵循不同推理轨迹的部分解，从而更可能覆盖不同的最终解。这两个目标之间的张力正是探索与利用权衡的一个实例，然而此前关于剪枝的工作几乎没有直接暴露这一权衡……
tldr: 该论文提出将 Pass@$k$ 直接作为思维剪枝的优化目标，从而在测试时推理中显式地平衡质量与多样性（即探索与利用）之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes directly optimizing Pass@$k$ as the objective for thought pruning, explicitly balancing the quality–diversity (exploration–exploitation) trade-off in test-time reasoning.
